description: Parses CSV with quoted fields and a header row into an array of objects, auto-detecting the delimiter; or converts an array of objects to CSV with mode=to_csv. 0.002 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

text.description: CSV text, or a JSON array of objects when mode=to_csv

name: csv_to_json
